name: Banh xeo with nem lui
summary: The 15 February 2023 culture page says bánh xèo is made in many provinces, and that the Ninh Bình plate is the crisp pancake with nem lụi and herbs. It does not claim the pancake was invented here.
origin: Ninh Bình, as the nem lụi plate on that page. This is not the southern crepe page.
howToEat: Eat it with rau sống and nem lụi. The page says people order it after a day of visiting.
where: Not pinned to one street. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh xeo with nem lui — Ninh Binh
seoDescription: The Ninh Bình pancake plate is bánh xèo with nem lụi and herbs, after a day of visiting.
